metadata.purpose: Shared responsive layout, input-modality behavior, interaction-state policy, and content-scale reflow contract.

foundations.intent: Linear flow that preserves semantic reading and action order while spacing remains token-driven.
Center a bounded content region without hard-coding a product page width.
Responsive multi-track layout whose track count follows available space, content scale, and task constraints.

guidance: Prefer one dominant reading and action flow.
Multi-track content must reduce tracks before readability, target size, or required actions degrade.
Compact viewport does not imply a mobile platform or a specific navigation component.
Allow supporting regions or multiple tracks only when task hierarchy stays obvious.
A rail or app-shell hook may become eligible, but viewport class alone does not select a concrete navigation component.
Content scale may force a compact-like composition without changing semantic component identity.
Allow persistent supporting regions and multi-track composition when content benefits from them.
Do not inflate action hierarchy or duplicate the same semantic control just because space is available.
Side-navigation and app-shell hooks remain downstream presentation choices.

rules: Critical actions and information must never require hover.
Touch-safe target sizing remains a platform-adapter responsibility and must not be reduced by responsive compaction.
Spacing, wrapping, and hit regions must tolerate imprecise direct manipulation.
Hover is additive feedback only and never the sole discoverability mechanism.
Pointer contexts may use denser presentation when readability and target requirements remain valid.
Pointer presence does not change Core semantics or authoritative state.
Focus order follows semantic reading and action order rather than visual column tricks.
Responsive recomposition must keep the focused control reachable and visible.
Every critical action in a keyboard-capable context requires an operable keyboard path.
Touch, pointer, and keyboard interaction remain simultaneously valid.
Pointer availability must not remove touch-safe targets or keyboard focus treatment.
Last-used modality may tune transient feedback, never semantic state or action hierarchy.

hover.rule: Optional enhancement only; required meaning or action cannot be hover-only.

focus-visible.rule: Must remain perceivable after responsive recomposition and cannot be delayed by motion.

pressed.rule: Transient activation feedback only; it does not replace selected, checked, open, loading, disabled, or authoritative state.

disabled.rule: Must preserve the underlying value/selection meaning while clearly removing operability.

selected-checked-open.rule: Authoritative component state stays modality-independent and must not be inferred from hover, focus, or press.

rules: Use the viewport contract normally while retaining semantic reading order.
Fixed control geometry may remain only when text/content is not clipped.
Wrap or grow before truncating required labels, body text, or actions.
Reduce grid track count or fall back to Stack before clipping or overlapping content.
Fixed content heights must yield unless the region is intentionally and independently scrollable.
Consume the T010 platform/host content-scale hook instead of assuming a numeric scale from platform name.
Resolve to runtime reflow without changing semantic component identity or action hierarchy.
When the concrete scale is unknown, choose the safer layout that preserves content rather than clipping.

integrationHooks.rule: Expose bounded-content and inline-size hooks without declaring a universal Container Core Component.
Expose region/offset hooks without promoting App Shell to Core before independent evidence and review.
T020 may map the shared navigation model to Side Navigation/Rail using viewport and environment context.
